deadline.value: Applications for the Fall semester are due January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Application deadline for the Fall Semester is January 15th

gre_general.value: The department recommends the general GRE, but does not require it.
gre_general.quote: Submission of Graduate Record Examination (general and subject GRE) scores is recommended, but not required

gre_subject.value: The department recommends the subject GRE, but does not require it.
gre_subject.quote: Submission of Graduate Record Examination (general and subject GRE) scores is recommended, but not required

toefl_min.value: Physics sets its own TOEFL minimum of 80 on the old internet-based scale, which differs from the Graduate School's new 4.5.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score for admission is 80 in the internet-based test

ielts_min.value: Physics requires an IELTS overall score of 6.5.

supervisor.value: Students choose a thesis advisor after the core courses, before their fourth semester, not for admission.
supervisor.quote: before the start of their 4th semester, the student is required to select a faculty member who consents to serve as their Ph.D. thesis advisor

funding.value: Physics lists research and teaching assistantships with a $33,950 nine-month stipend, but does not say most or all admitted students get one.
funding.quote: Research and teaching assistantships include a stipend of $33,950 per nine months

entry_route.value: Physics considers applicants with a B.S. in physics or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Consideration is given to applicants who have a B.S. degree in physics (or related field)

notes: Physics page: applicants from non-English-speaking countries need TOEFL or IELTS even after US courses. Financial aid is automatic on application.
